description: Use this when the user wants to redesign their room from a photo, see a different interior style in their own home, prepare a floor-plan concept or a materials/lighting proposal, or compare ABIS styles. Returns a direct ABIS photo-upload link with optional room/style choices preserved, plus the photo-only consulting workflow, PDF and automatic sharing options. No written brief is required. This tool prepares the website entry only: it does not receive photos, start generation, use image credits or expose a personal workspace. Do not use for unrelated image creation or force image design into a general information/price question.

room.description: Room selected by the user; auto when unspecified. Do not guess from a private photo.

source.description: Known AI client for the handoff link: chatgpt, claude, gemini, meta; mcp when unknown.

style.description: Style explicitly chosen by the user; recommended when unspecified. A written brief is optional on the website.
